items.title: Show HN: bouncemarket – a live prediction market game for a bouncing ball
items.text: a ball will fall. trade on where it lands. I made this game! Some technical details: The entire drop of the ball is simulated server-side, then streamed to each client as server-sent events with a small buffer. Every drop is deterministic from its starting position, so rounds can be replayed exactly for later analysis, but tiny variations in starting position can change the ultimate outcome. There's some AI traders to keep the market moving, but they drop out in any round that has more than five people. items.text: Release: datasette-charts 0.4a0 The new datasette-charts plugin has its own plugin hook to allow other plugins to define new chart types, but I hadn't actually used it for anything yet. I had Claude Opus 5.5 build an experimental plugins just to try out the hook and it came up with a bunch of friction points in the design. This release addresses those, which should make building additional chart plugins a whole lot more ergonomic. I've also added a website for the plugin, at charts.datasette.io .
